excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]附近有非常奇特的能源信号，好像整个星球都在时隐时现一样。
excerpt.en: Enigmatic energy readings surround [From.GetName], as though the entire planet is wavering in and out of existence.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的轨道上有了惊人的发现。该星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为面纱的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

不仅如此，星球周围粒子场中的量子态数量仍在稳定增长。目前没有确凿的理论可以解释这一现象。[Root.GetLeaderName]假设灵能——

通讯变成了杂讯。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an incredible discovery in orbit of [From.GetName]. The planet possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed The Veil, exists simultaneously in two dimensions: our own, and an unknown other.

What is more, the number of quantum states in the particle fields surrounding the planet is increasing at a constant rate. As of yet, there is no confirmed theory that could account for this phenomenon. [Root.GetLeaderName] posits that the psionic energy surr ---

The transmission crackles out to static.

label.en: What is going on out there?

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员为其初次报告被打断而道歉。在通讯中，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历了一次彻底的维度转移，它的粒子场旋转进了另一个维度！灵能云团已经消散，显露了一颗宝贵的盖亚星球。

迷人的是，随着星球的转移，其量子叠加态似乎已被重置，并且正在以星球仍被虚境星球时同等的速度增长。

[Root.GetLeaderName]用量子叠加态的增长速度，以及转移时的量子叠加态总量，推测出星球的转移周期为三个月。或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得拥有星系的控制权。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew apologizes for the abrupt termination of their initial report. During transmission, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experienced a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another! The cloud of psionic energy has been lifted, revealing a glittering jewel of a Gaia World.

Fascinatingly, the number of superimposed quantum states appears to have been reset as the planet shifted, and is now increasing at the same rate as when the planet was a Shrouded World.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts. Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]周围的残余能源读数表明，不久之前这颗星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为面纱的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

该星球已经被锁定在当前的相位维度，应该可以安全地进行殖民。
texts.en:
Residual energy readings surrounding [From.GetName] indicate the planet not too long ago possessed a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed The Veil, existed simultaneously in two dimensions in the not-too-distant past: our own, and an unknown other.

The planet has since been locked into its current dimensional phase, and should be considered safe for colonization.
